name: Douyin Live Chat
description: Interact with a Douyin live stream: follow streamer, send danmaku (chat messages), read chat history. Uses AppleScript + Chrome JS + cliclick.
usage:
PYTHONPATH=~/.clawbie/toolkits/douyin-live python3 -c "
from douyin_live.tools import <func>
print(<func>(...))
"

Available functions:
- open_live(room_id) — open a live stream room
- get_live_info() — get streamer name, viewer count, etc.
- follow_streamer() — follow the streamer (cliclick)
- read_chat(count=20) — read recent chat messages
- send_chat(text) — send a danmaku message
- wait() — random 3-5s delay for anti-bot
install: Requires macOS + Google Chrome + cliclick (brew install cliclick). Accessibility permission required.
